title: Every fixed bounded symmetric negative-kurtosis seed pays cubic matched-defect coefficient at least one quarter

inputs.seed_class: X is one fixed bounded symmetric centered unit-variance seed with kappa_4(X)=-u<0.

coefficient.equality: c_X=1/4 if and only if kappa_6(X)=0.

scope_guard: The theorem is a fixed-seed weak-channel asymptotic. It is not yet uniform over g-dependent seeds and does not order exact finite-strength MMSE curves, correlated tensors, Haar savings or unrestricted stationary laws.
